description: Reusable knowledge entry schema for Islamic History AI. Copy this shape when adding new verified historical entries.

entry_template.title: Human-readable title
entry_template.category: prophet | seerah | battle | treaty | caliph | dynasty | civilization | scholar | science | culture | event | timeline | source
entry_template.disputed_notes: Optional. Explain disagreements without taking a sectarian side.

sources.author: Author name
sources.type: classical seerah | classical historical source | modern academic | encyclopedic | textbook

certainty_guide.established_traditional: Widely attested in mainstream historical narratives with relatively stable core facts (still may have detail disputes).
certainty_guide.traditional_account: Important in Islamic tradition but not tightly dated or independently confirmed in secular chronology.
certainty_guide.disputed: Significant disagreement among sources on key facts.
certainty_guide.sectarian_difference: Sunni and Shia (or other) historical traditions narrate differently — present neutrally.

adding_knowledge_steps: 1. Choose the correct JSON file in /knowledge (or create a new file and register it in lib/retrieval/retriever.js).
2. Copy the entry_template and fill every field carefully.
5. Only list sources you have actually checked; otherwise use needs_verification.
6. Have a qualified reviewer check historical claims before treating them as production-ready.
